profile.headline: Software Engineering & Space Operations | Optical & RF Systems
profile.summary: ✨ Software solutions enabling science, launch, and spacecraft operations. Contributing to our collective understanding of the universe!🚀

positions.title: Software Engineer (Ground Segment - Falcon & Dragon Avionics & Software Engineering)
positions.description:
Development of streamlined software architecture for integrated mission planning (Python, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, CI/CD) and RF ground station control (C++) across all vehicle programs. Responsible Engineer for Falcon program operational validation and mission roll-out.

Software maintenance and optimization across RF communications and optical tracking assets.

positions.title: Ground Segment Engineer (Falcon & Dragon Avionics & Software Engineering)
positions.description:
Ground station and optical tracking operator for Falcon and Dragon missions (40+ missions).

Mission planning and RF link analysis for customer and government missions.

Implementation of ground station automation enhancements (yaml, C++) and improvements to mission planning and link analysis software tools (Python, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, CI/CD).

positions.title: Flight Operations Systems Engineer III - Flight Planning and Design
positions.description:
Dream Chaser Flight Controller and Simulation Instructor.

Development of integrated mission timelines, conops, flight rules, procedures and displays.

Test plan creation and execution for software certification and migrations.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Requirements · Project Management · Launches · Teamwork · Mission Operations

positions.title: Principal Science Operations Specialist
positions.description:
World class telescope, instruments, and adaptive optics operations, testing and calibration.

Chair of operational software group, developing and maintaining operational scripts.

Queue coordination, scheduling and time allocation support.
positions.insights: Skills: Teamwork · Python (Programming Language) · Software Development · Systems Engineering · Problem Solving · Stressful Situations

positions.title: NASA's Curiosity Rover (MSL) Science Collaborator and Flight Operations
positions.description:
Science Team Mission Operations:
Environmental Group (ENV) Lead and Keeper of the Plan (2017-2019)
Certified Geological and Mineralogical (GEO) Group Keeper of the Plan (2018-2019)

Science Team Collaborator (2017-2019):
Proposed and developed a new atmospheric monitoring observation that is still regularly observed on Curiosity (Phase Function Sky Survey)

positions.title: Visiting Student Researcher
positions.description:
Developed scripts to calibrate, process, and analyze rover temperature measurements to investigate the radiative effects of Martian water ice clouds at night (bash, Python).

Presented scientific validation of Environmental Science Team observations to the Curiosity/MSL Engineering Cameras (ECAM) team and sat for an ECAM payload uplink lead operational shadow shift.

positions.title: Graduate and Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research Assistant in the Planetary Volatiles Lab (PVL) at the Centre for Research in Earth and Space Science (2014-2019)

York Dept. of Earth and Space Science and Engineering (ESSE) Tenure and Promotions committee Undergraduate Representative (2016-2017)

Helix Summer Science Institute Analog Mars Mission Facilitator (2017)
positions.insights: Skills: Satellite Imagery · Programming · Data Analysis · Data Science · Public Speaking · Statistical Analysis Tools · Communication · Observational Astronomy · Software Development · Matlab · Image Analysis · Spacecraft · Organization Skills · Research · Linux · Problem Solving

educations.fieldOfStudy: Atmospheric Science and Astronomy w/ concurrent Meteorology Certificate

honors.title: Lassonde School of Engineering Research Medal
honors.description: The Lassonde School of Engineering Research Medal is awarded annually to an outstanding graduating undergraduate student in the Lassonde School of Engineering showing promise as a researcher.
honors.issuer: Issued by Lassonde School of Engineering, York University · Jul 2018

honors.title: Technologies for Exo-Planetary Science (TEPS) Masters Research Grant
honors.description: Technologies for Exo-Planetary Science (TEPS) CREATE program addresses the primary objectives of the CREATE program, made possible by the generous support of the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council (NSERC) of Canada, by offering students and PDFs innovative and collaborative learning environments, incorporating internships, student mobility and professional training.

volunteerExperiences.description:
CAP Senior Member with a focus on airborne Emergency Services operations qualifications:
o Qualified Search and Rescue Mission Scanner
o Qualified Mission Observer 
o Aerial Photographer (training in progress)
o Mission Radio Operator (training in progress)

Volunteer in community science and STEM outreach events led by Gemini Observatory and Mauna Kea Observatories (including AstroDay, Merrie Monarch Parade, Onizuka Day, Tutoring in Credit Recovery at Hilo High School, and an ambassador for the Hawai'i Island Journey Through the Universe program).

publications.title: Academic Publications (click link to access Google Scholar)

organizations.name: Civil Air Patrol
organizations.description:
CAP Senior Member with a focus on Emergency Services flight operations.
Qualified Search and Rescue Flight Mission Scanner, Mission Observer Training and Aerial Photographer training in progress.

organizations.name: American Astronomical Society - Division of Planetary Sciences
